name: run-error-first-run-continues
description: a stream may OPEN with RUN_ERROR — the spec admits it, because a run can fail before it begins — so the client raises no first-event violation; the failure is delivered to the application as an event, and consuming the stream is not itself a failure
kill: narrow the first-event check in verifyEvents (`eventType !== RUN_STARTED && eventType !== RUN_ERROR`) to RUN_STARTED alone — the leading RUN_ERROR is then rejected with `First event must be 'RUN_STARTED'`, the run ends failed and no RUN_ERROR reaches the application, so `outcome`, `eventTypes` and `runError` all fail together
